import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income Distribution by Education Level
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Income'])
education_order = ['Basic', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD'] if 'Basic' in df['Education'].values else df['Education'].unique()
sns.boxplot(data=df_clean, y='Education', x='Income', ax=ax1, palette='Set2')
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)')

# 2. Total Spending by Product Category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
total_spending = df[spending_cols].sum()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(spending_cols)))
ax2.barh([col.replace('Mnt', '') for col in spending_cols], total_spending, color=colors)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Amount ($)')

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
current_year = 2014  # Based on customer dates
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax3.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 4. Purchase Channel Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = df[channels].sum()
colors_pie = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff', '#99ff99']
ax4.pie(channel_totals, labels=[c.replace('Num', '').replace('Purchases', '') for c in channels], 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Purchase Channel Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Income vs Total Spending
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
ax5.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=50)
ax5.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Income ($)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax5.collections[0], ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Age')

# 6. Family Composition
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
family_counts = df['TotalKids'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.bar(family_counts.index, family_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_title('Number of Children at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')

# 7. Campaign Response Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
response_rates = df[campaign_cols].sum() / len(df) * 100
ax7.bar(range(len(campaign_cols)), response_rates, color='mediumpurple', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(campaign_cols)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response'], rotation=45)
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)')

# 8. Marital Status Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
ax8.bar(marital_counts.index, marital_counts.values, color='lightgreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_title('Customer Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Marital Status')
ax8.set_ylabel('Count')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 9. Recency vs Web Visits
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.scatter(df['Recency'], df['NumWebVisitsMonth'], alpha=0.6, color='orange', s=50)
ax9.set_title('Recency vs Web Visits', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase')
ax9.set_ylabel('Web Visits per Month')

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Campaign Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
